say:3:1810768202:1.text: Come on, be a little more confident. You've got the right guy!
say:3:1810768202:1.source_cn: 大胆点，你没认错，就是我！
say:3:1810768202:1.male: Come on, be a little more confident. You've got the right guy!
say:3:1810768202:1.female: Come on, be a little more confident. You've got the right guy!

say:4:1810768204:1.text: As you can see, that machine in the Refinery turned me into a Graveborn.
say:4:1810768204:1.source_cn: 如你所见，我被炼化间里那个巨型机器转化成了亡灵。
say:4:1810768204:1.male: As you can see, that machine in the Refinery turned me into a Graveborn.
say:4:1810768204:1.female: As you can see, that machine in the Refinery turned me into a Graveborn.

say:5:1810768205:1.text: The process hurt like hell, sure, but come on. I look pretty cool now, don't I?
say:5:1810768205:1.source_cn: 虽然转化的过程确实疼得厉害……不过我现在的样子还挺酷的吧？
say:5:1810768205:1.male: The process hurt like hell, sure, but come on. I look pretty cool now, don't I?
say:5:1810768205:1.female: The process hurt like hell, sure, but come on. I look pretty cool now, don't I?

say:9:1810768207:1.text: Alright, alright. Stop looking so miserable. Becoming a Graveborn isn't the end of the world. I won't get sick, and I don't have to worry about eating or sleeping anymore. Sounds like a pretty sweet deal.
say:9:1810768207:1.source_cn: 好了好了，别为了我愁眉苦脸的，变成亡灵又不是一件坏事。...

say:10:1810768208:1.text: Besides, Novaris has always been a sanctuary for the Graveborn. If I kept living here as a human, that would've been the strange part.
say:10:1810768208:1.source_cn: 再说了，诺珐斯本来就是一座亡灵城镇。如果我一直以生者的...

say:12:1810768210:1.text: Of course. If not here, where else would I go?
say:12:1810768210:1.source_cn: 是啊，我不留在这里，还要去哪？

say:16:1810768212:0.text: Hmph... I'm afraid that may not be your choice to make.
say:16:1810768212:0.source_cn: 哼……只怕你想留也留不下来。

say:17:1810768213:1.text: You destroyed the Soul Forge. Bantus won't let that go... If you stay in Novaris, you'll only bring disaster upon this city.
say:17:1810768213:1.source_cn: 转化器被你们损毁，班题斯肯定不会善罢甘休……留在诺珐斯...

say:18:1810768214:1.text: "I" destroyed it? Baba, I'm pretty sure I saw you take part too.
say:18:1810768214:1.source_cn: 我们？婆婆，我明明看见你也去砸过机器啊。

say:19:1810768215:0.text: Don't talk back to your elders! If it weren't for saving your life, I never would've made an enemy of Bantus!
say:19:1810768215:0.source_cn: ——不要和老身顶嘴！若不是为了救你，老身不会不自量力地...

say:20:1810768216:0.text: Alright, alright... Don't be mad. I know you were only looking out for me.
say:20:1810768216:0.source_cn: 啊好好好……别生气，婆婆，我知道你都是为了我好。

say:24:1810768218:1.text: Baden... You're nothing like how you were before you lost your memories.
say:24:1810768218:1.source_cn: 巴登……和失忆前完全不一样了……

say:26:1810768219:1.text: Oh? Now I'm curious. What was the former head of House Rayne like before?
say:26:1810768219:1.source_cn: 哦，是吗？余很好奇，耀光帝国瑞恩家族的前任家主……失忆...

say:27:1810768220:1.text: Perhaps we should try restoring those memories and find out.
say:27:1810768220:1.source_cn: 不如，帮他恢复记忆试试？

say:28:1810768221:1.text: Really? You can help me recover my memories?!
say:28:1810768221:1.source_cn: 真的吗？你有办法帮我找回记忆？！

say:29:1810768222:1.text: You... Lady Novaris, "Sloth" of the Adamant Syndicate. Are you planning another scheme like with the candle blossoms?!
say:29:1810768222:1.source_cn: 你……诺珐斯的领主，黑金商会的“懒惰”……你想做什么？...

say:32:1810768223:0.text: The candle blossom issue was merely a misunderstanding. Lady Tephesia already explained it to me. She never intended to harm the empire.
say:32:1810768223:0.source_cn: 赤烛蕊只是一场误会。苔佩希阁下已经向我解释过。其实她并...

say:33:1810768224:0.text: Do put away those claws, Miss Rayne. As for Bantus and the Syndicate, I've been more ally than enemy to the Lightbearer Empire. My cooperation with them was merely a matter of necessity...
say:33:1810768224:0.source_cn: 放下你的敌意吧，瑞恩小姐。在班题斯和黑金之事上，余或许...

say:34:1810768225:0.text: <style="highlight">The cure for memory loss is right over there on that alchemy bench in the corner</style>. I acquired it from the Refinery. I... *Cough*... require a bit more rest.

choice_prompt:39:1810768228.text: Then could that medicine restore your memories too?
choice_prompt:39:1810768228.source_cn: 那她说的解药是不是也能帮你恢复记忆？
choice_prompt:39:1810768228.male: Then could that medicine restore your memories too?
choice_prompt:39:1810768228.female: Then could that medicine restore your memories too?

say:42:1810768229:0.text: Her Ladyship would never harm her own people without a good reason. There's no use wasting your energy worrying about that.
say:42:1810768229:0.source_cn: 领主阁下绝不可能平白无故伤害诺珐斯的亡灵，用不着生者担忧。

say:45:1810768230:0.text: Rain, if you truly wish to recover your memories, go fetch the cure. As long as I'm here, nobody will stop you.
say:45:1810768230:0.source_cn: 里纳，若是你真想找回记忆，就去取来解药吧。有老身在，没...

say:46:1810768231:0.text: Thanks, Baba. I'll go get it right away.
say:46:1810768231:0.source_cn: 谢谢你，婆婆，我这就去拿解药。

say:50:1810768232:0.text:
Wait!
Have you... really thought this through?

say:51:1810768233:0.text: If I want to get my memories back, why wouldn't I do it?

say:52:1810768234:1.text: I love Novaris, but my life shouldn't revolve around it. I want my past back. I want to know the man you all call "Baden".
say:52:1810768234:1.source_cn: 虽然我很喜欢诺珐斯，但我的人生不应该围绕着它转。我想找...

say:53:1810768235:1.text: And wouldn't you and Thane be happy if I got my memories back?
say:53:1810768235:1.source_cn: 要是我真的找回了记忆，你和瑟恩不是也该感到高兴吗？

say:57:1810768238:1.text: I'll get the cure for him.
